subject: Tri-party demo: Horizon Systems + EdgeScale (Azure Marketplace)
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@microsoft.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Cc: alex.chen@horizon-systems.com
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Opportunity: tri-party demo with Horizon & EdgeScale

Hi Rachel,

Azure Marketplace team here — we have a promising Horizon Systems opportunity that wants to see a short technical showcase before committing to the marketplace listing. Horizon (cc'd) would like a joint session with Redwood + EdgeScale (their SI).

Their ask: 45-minute joint demo (25m Redwood platform walkthrough + 15m SI integration + 5m next steps). Prefer week of Oct 4. Two suggested windows: Tue, Oct 5 09:00–09:45 PT or Wed, Oct 6 12:00–12:45 PT.

Can Redwood provide an ops lead and a technical host for the 25-minute segment? We also need a short runbook and the slide deck to circulate to the buyer. We'll handle the marketplace coordination and invite.

Let me know who from Redwood will present and which window works; we'll confirm with EdgeScale.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Partner PM, Azure Marketplace
Microsoft

--
Attachments: none in first pass
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@microsoft.com>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@horizon-systems.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Opportunity: tri-party demo with Horizon & EdgeScale

Thanks Maya — appreciate the intro and context.

Quick answers: we can host the 25-minute technical walkthrough. Proposed plan: 20–25 minutes product + live integration example (quantize inference, routing policy), 15 minutes SI demo, 5 minutes close/action items. Logistics we need from EdgeScale: presenter name, whether they'll demo a connector or full integration, and any network/security preflight requirements.

We should lock the Wed, Oct 6 12:00–12:45 PT window to give teams time to prep — ok with everyone?

I've attached a short runbook and our latest demo slides (slide deck is a stub; will trim to 12 slides). Also adding Vanessa (partner lead) to coordinate invitations and Sergio (solutions) + Monica (ops) for environment/runbook checks.

If EdgeScale can confirm by EOD tomorrow we can finalize calendar + invite.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0147

--
Attachments: marketplace_runbook_v2.pdf, redwood_demo_slides_v3.pptx
From: Priya Khatri <priya.k@edgescale.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@microsoft.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@horizon-systems.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Opportunity: tri-party demo with Horizon & EdgeScale

Thanks Maya / Rachel — Priya from EdgeScale here. Wed, Oct 6 12:00–12:45 PT works for our team. We'll plan for a 15-minute SI segment focused on integration and deployment patterns (including our connector to Horizon's data plane) and 10 minutes for Q&A. Presenters: Priya Khatri (me) + Mark Rivera (SE, will join for live demo).

One ask: can Redwood include a brief run-through of fallback behavior if primary GPU capacity is constrained? Horizon has been asking about reliability SLA behaviors under burst. Also confirm if we should rehearse in a pre-meeting 30-minute dry run on Oct 5.

Priya Khatri
Senior Solutions Architect, EdgeScale
priya.k@edgescale.com

--
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.patel@microsoft.com>, priya.k@edgescale.com, alex.chen@horizon-systems.com
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Opportunity: tri-party demo with Horizon & EdgeScale

Team — quick ops checklist before I confirm the invite:
- Vanessa: please own invites + HubSpot activity (HS-892274). Add Horizon AE and Azure PM.
- Monica: can we reserve a failover room and a secondary presenter? Prefer a 30-min dry run on Tue, Oct 5 09:30–10:00 PT. Monica, can you confirm availability?
- Sergio: you'll cover the fallback/SLA behaviors in the live demo — plan for a 5-slide micro-run explaining routing fallback and cache priming.

Priya: yes to the dry run. We will include a two-slide section on graceful degradation + model variant fallback.

If we get confirmation from Monica today I'll send the calendar invite and a short pre-read (runbook + slides).

Rachel

From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@microsoft.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Priya Khatri <priya.k@edgescale.com>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@horizon-systems.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Wed Oct 6 12:00–12:45 PT — Tri-party demo (calendar invite attached)

All — confirmed. Calendar invite attached (.ics). Draft agenda: 1) 5m intros, 2) 25m Redwood technical demo (Sergio), 3) 15m EdgeScale integration (Priya), 4) 5m next steps + marketplace listing cadence.

Action items: Rachel to share runbook and final slide deck; Vanessa to log HubSpot activity and send invite to Horizon procurement thread; Monica to run dry-run Oct 5 09:30 PT.

See you Wednesday.

Maya Patel

Microsoft
